Definition
[Cayley graph and Cayley complex]

↗ cor:every-group-realized-as-pi1 \group Covering Spaces

For $G=\langle g_\alpha \mid r_\beta \rangle $, the Cayley graph has vertex set $G$ and an edge $g\to gg_\alpha $ for each generator. Attach a 2-cell along each translate of every relator to obtain the Cayley complex $\widetilde X_G$. Left multiplication by $G$ is a covering space action and $\widetilde X_G/G=X_G$.
